# gigahost_dns_zones (Data Source)

Returns all DNS zones on your gigahost.no account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "zone_names" {
  value = [for z in data.gigahost_dns_zones.all.zones : z.name]
}
```
